deep_dive.title: $ω$-0: A Latent Predictive World Action Model for Concurrent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
deep_dive.abstract: Humanoid household tasks often require concurrent loco-manipulation, where the robot must move, adjust posture, maintain balance, and manipulate objects as a single coordinated behavior. Yet existing humanoid policies typically decompose locomotion and manipulation, while recent world-action models remain either arm-centric or video-centered. We present $ω$-0, a latent predictive whole-body world-action model for real-world humanoid concurrent loco-manipulation. Given a language instruction, current visual observation, and robot proprioceptive state, $ω$-0 directly predicts controller-compatible whole-body action latents for real-robot execution. Rather than reconstructing future videos, $ω$-0 learns compact future observation embeddings as a lightweight predictive objective, coupling latent visual foresight with diffusion-based whole-body action generation. The model supports egocentric RGB, exocentric RGB, and exocentric depth inputs, and leverages controller-based simulation replay to ground human/public visual-motion priors into robot-executable action latents. We further collect $ω$-HOME, a 40+ hour real-world household humanoid dataset with synchronized multi-view observations, whole-body SMPL motions, robot states, and action latents. Real-world experiments on 11 household tasks demonstrate that a single $ω$-0 model can produce smooth manipulate-while-moving behaviors and consistently outperform representative imitation learning, VLA, humanoid, and WAM baselines.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: We present ω-0, a latent predictive whole-body world-action model that directly predicts controller-compatible whole-body action latents for real humanoid loco-manipulation, learning compact future observation embeddings.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 现有类人形策略通常将移动与操作分解处理，而最近的世界动作模型或只关注手臂或只关注视频。为此，本文提出ω-0，一个隐式预测全身世界动作模型，基于语言指令、视觉观测和本体感觉状态直接预测控制器兼容的全身动作隐向量，无需重建未来视频，而是学习紧凑的未来观测嵌入。实验表明该模型能在真实人形机器人上实现并发移动操作，展示了学习世界模型控制机器人的潜力。
